description:
Create, list, show and delete thread files (Projects, Processes, Topics).

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list threads; open ones only by default
  show THREAD [--json] — show one thread file
  new --name NAME --kind KIND --category CATEGORY [--currency CODE] [--rate N] — create a thread file
  delete THREAD -y — permanently delete a thread file

Args:
  QUERY  optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity
  THREAD  a name or 'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/SGB

Flags:
  list: --all includes paused and closed threads. --json gives JSON output.
  show: --json gives JSON output.
  new: --name is required; it becomes the filename and must not contain '/' or start with '.'. --kind is required: project, process or topic (sets the directory: Projects, Processes, Topics). --category is required: professional, personal or voluntary. --currency is the 3-letter ISO default for hours and makes the thread billable. --rate is the default hourly rate for hours and needs --currency.
  delete: -y (or --yes) is required.

Examples:
  ["list", "sgb", "--all", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "1500"]

Notes:
  A thread must exist before notes, buffer entries, hours or payments can reference it.
  delete is permanent.
  Exit 1: empty name, invalid name, thread already exists, --rate without --currency, delete without -y.
